snippet.title: Pandemonium gameplay (PC Game, 1996)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Pandemonium, PC game produced by Crystal Dynamics in 1996 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/pandemonium/975/
Playing through the first stage of this 2.5D platform game originally developed for Playstation.
Played through emulated Windows (Win 98/Win XP) virtual machine.
Recorded with original sound.

Similar videos you may like:
Pandemonium 2 - https://youtu.be/3Wo5OUYFcnE
